notes: Abu Salama narrates his own entry with Aisha's brother («دخلت أنا وأخو عائشة»). Aisha's ghusl is an act described, not a speech, so she is not a link; the last link is Abu Salama.
«قال أبو عبد الله قال يزيد بن هارون وبهز والجدي عن شعبة قدر صاع» is the compiler's remark naming other transmitters of a fragment: a variant group, never a route (rule 4).
